# Read data
data <- read.csv(Sys.getenv("INPUT_CSV"))

# Exclude Strain 1 (unrelated strain)
data <- subset(data, StrainNumber != 1)

# Compute proportion of strain 287 from Ratio and StrainNumber
compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == "287" && ratio == "1:0") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98" && ratio == "1:0") return(0.0)
  # For 287_98 mixtures: ratio "a:b" means a parts 287 to b parts 98
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]]
  a <- as.numeric(parts[1])
  b <- as.numeric(parts[2])
  return(a / (a + b))
}

data$Prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, data$StrainNumber, data$Ratio)

library(splines)

# Quadratic model
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Prop287 + I(Prop287^2), data = data)

# Cubic model
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Prop287 + I(Prop287^2) + I(Prop287^3), data = data)

# Natural spline with df=4
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Prop287, df = 4), data = data)

# Compare by AIC
aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

aics <- c(quadratic = aic_quad, cubic = aic_cubic, spline = aic_spline)
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- switch(best_name,
  quadratic = m_quad,
  cubic = m_cubic,
  spline = m_spline
)

# Predict over fine grid [0, 1]
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
newdata <- data.frame(Prop287 = grid)
pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = newdata)

# Find maximum
max_idx <- which.max(pred)
optimal_freq <- grid[max_idx]
max_area <- pred[max_idx]

# Output results
sink("/output/results.txt")
cat("Best model:", best_name, "\n\n")
cat("AIC values:\n")
for (m in names(aics)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %.4f\n", m, aics[m]))
}
cat("\n")
cat(sprintf("Optimal proportion of strain 287: %.6f\n", optimal_freq))
cat(sprintf("Maximum predicted colony area: %.6f\n", max_area))
sink()
REOF
